title: A Software Engineering Perspective on Testing Large Language Models: Research, Practice, Tools and Benchmarks

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not directly conduct empirical bias measurements on models; instead, it surveys the landscape of LLM testing by categorizing existing ML evaluation benchmarks (e.g., CrowS-Pairs), open-source testing tools, and online practitioner discussions to determine the extent to which fairness, toxicity, and social biases are currently being tested in practice.
